title: 15 Things I Wish I Knew In My Early 20s
author: Simple Men
summary: A reflective list of 15 pieces of wisdom covering financial prudence (only invest in what you understand), mental health (avoid news sensationalism), personal discipline (alcohol and sexual immorality as dependencies), character development, and discernment. The advice emphasizes that true freedom comes from mastery over base desires and that imitation of Christ rather than any human figure provides the steadiest guide.
points: Only invest in things you understand; everything else is gambling.
Avoid news and sensationalism that floods your mind with negativity and death.
Mastery over sexual immorality builds character like nothing else.
Do not idolize any human; imitate Christ alone.
Movies and soft content can weaken the heart; be intentional about what you consume.
quotes: Only invest in things you understand. Otherwise you are just gambling.
The praise you get from other lost, desperate men won't ever compensate the damage you are doing to your own soul.
Defeating sexual immorality will build your character like nothing else.
All men are flawed, and while you can learn something from everyone, be wary of gurus and false messiahs.
Too much movie make your heart weak.” Archived from Simple Men on May 2, 2026 by Tim.
